## Question

How do 30-day hospital readmission rates compare between male and female patients across different racial groups?

## Main figure

```{r}
#| label: main-figure
#| eval: false
library(tidyverse)

my_data <- read_csv("../data/tidy/your_file.csv")
# Your ggplot code here; add fig-cap and fig-alt
```

## What it shows

The figure shows that readmission rates are generally similar between male and female patients, although some racial groups show slightly higher or lower rates than others.

## Limitations

The data come from the Fairness dataset, where each row represents one patient record. Some racial groups have smaller sample sizes than others, which can make comparisons less reliable. The data can show differences between groups but cannot determine the causes of those differences or whether race or gender directly affected readmission outcomes.
